name: TCGA H&E slides (GBM; LGG; LUAD; LUSC; BRCA; SKCM; KIRC; COAD; READ)
used_for: Triage: glioma (GBM IDH-wildtype; LGG IDH-mutant); non-CNS / metastasis (other organs)
notes: FFPE diagnostic slides; Leica and some Carl Zeiss scanners

name: GTEx cerebral cortex H&E slides
used_for: Triage: normal brain
notes: PAXgene-fixed and post-mortem; the only normal brain source so far

name: CCDI-MCI H&E slides
used_for: Triage: other primary CNS; the 3 real brain metastases
notes: Paediatric; also has gliomas (not used yet)

name: HCMI and CGCI H&E slides
used_for: Triage: a few gliomas; metastases; lymphoma
notes: Too few patients to train on

name: CPTAC H&E slides (GBM; COAD; LUAD; LSCC; BRCA; CCRCC; CM; others)
used_for: Second source per non-CNS organ; third glioma source
notes: Fixative not recorded in IDC (prep 'unknown'); CPTAC-GBM needs IDH from a CPTAC study

name: TCGA pan-glioma clinical table (lgggbm_tcga_pub; Ceccarelli et al. 2016)
licence_or_terms: TCGA open-access derived; cite the paper and cBioPortal
used_for: IDH filter for the diverse triage set; panel labels (IDH; 1p/19q; ATRX; TERT; MGMT; +7/-10)
notes: No separate licence stated on the API

name: TCGA open-access molecular data (450K/EPIC betas; mutations; copy number; clinical)
licence_or_terms: GDC open access; follow TCGA publication guidelines
used_for: Methylation (step 5) pairs; panel labels for TP53; CDKN2A/B; EGFR; H3
notes: DNA from a frozen portion; not the FFPE slide

name: GSE90496 methylation reference (Capper et al. 2018)
used_for: Labels for methylation class (step 5)
notes: 2682 tumours in 82 classes; terms to confirm

name: Digital Brain Tumour Atlas (Roetzer-Pejrimovsky et al. 2022)
licence_or_terms: EBRAINS Data Use Agreement for pseudonymised human data; cite DOI; no commercial use
used_for: External test set only (never trained on): 126 tumour types; real metastases; lymphoma; Hamamatsu scanner (training/runs/dbta)
notes: Personal data under GDPR; training on it may count as commercial derivative: ask the owners first

name: IPD-Brain (Chauhan et al. 2024; Sci Data)
provider: India Data (IHub-Data; IIIT Hyderabad); slides from NIMS Hyderabad
licence_or_terms: India Data DUA: research and other lawful use; no commercial use without the provider's written consent; attribution; DPDPA 2023; Indian law
used_for: External test set only (never trained on): 328 glioma patients; 484 labelled slides; Indian population; Morphle DigiPath scanner (training/runs/ipd)
notes: IDH from IHC (IDH1 R132H) only; no normal or other CNS; Figshare copy (10.6084/m9.figshare.27186087) is CC BY 4.0 but about 12 GB (likely downsampled); training needs written consent

name: BRAIN-UK
used_for: UK/NHS tissue and slides for training and testing
notes: Neuropath-AI's largest external test set (UCL) came through BRAIN-UK

name: Children's Brain Tumor Network (CBTN)
used_for: Paediatric CNS tumours
notes: Used by Neuropath-AI and DEPLOY

name: BraTS-Path 2024
used_for: Necrosis / MVP region labels (step 3)

name: Ivy Glioblastoma Atlas (Ivy GAP)
used_for: Region labels (step 3)

name: LUNG-MITO
used_for: Step 3c: train the mitosis finder and checker; never used as glioma evidence
notes: Manual polygon masks; human lung adenocarcinoma; 10 patients; 4,803 mitoses; no brain; recheck licence at download

name: stMIDOG++ masks
licence_or_terms: CC BY 4.0 (annotations); images come from MIDOG++
used_for: Step 3c: train the mitosis finder and checker with MIDOG++ images
notes: Manual polygon masks; 11,936 mitoses and 14,347 look-alikes; human and canine; no brain; not exhaustive; masks on look-alikes unconfirmed

name: MIDOG++ images and labels
licence_or_terms: CC0 on labels and 499 of 503 image records; sources also state MIT or CC BY for some images
used_for: Step 3c: images for stMIDOG++ masks
notes: Exclude the 4 image records with unconfirmed licence; keep attribution; no brain; not exhaustive

name: gbm-db annotations
used_for: Step 3c: weak glioma labels for fine-tuning only; never for testing or measuring misses
notes: Boxes not masks; TCGA glioblastoma; 3,487 figures; not exhaustive; some unreviewed model predictions; use only slides matched to IDC (CC BY 3.0); exclude reserved test patients

name: CMC
used_for: Step 3c: optional extra training for the finder only
notes: Centre points; canine mammary carcinoma; about 13,900 mitoses; exhaustive for mitoses; not glioma evidence

name: CCMCT
used_for: Step 3c: optional extra training for the finder only
notes: Annotation geometry unconfirmed; canine mast cell tumour; 44,880 mitoses; not glioma evidence

name: OMG-Octo

name: OMG-Octo Atypical

name: MIDOG 2025 atypical labels
used_for: Blocked: must not train the counter or choose cells for labelling

name: Multi-lab Stained and Multi-scanner Scanned Sarcoma WSI Dataset

Not CNS, and only 14 cases, so split by case and do not use for tumour-class training. Paper: https://doi.org/10.1002/2056-4538.70080 (its data statement not read)
